mapper.select: SELECT idc.installment_delinquency_charge_id AS charge_id, idc.delinquency_charge - idc.paid_delinquency_charge AS unpaid_delinquency_charge, 0 AS unpaid_interest FROM installment_delinquency_charge idc JOIN repayment_schedule rs ON rs.repayment_schedule_id = idc.repayment_schedule_id WHERE rs.loan_account_id = #{loanAccountId} AND rs.repayment_schedule_status_id NOT IN (#{closedByAcceleration}, #{closedByMaturityOverdue}) AND idc.delinquency_charge > idc.paid_delinquency_charge ORDER BY idc.charge_date, idc.installment_delinquency_charge_id

SELECT repayment_schedule_id, scheduled_interest - paid_interest AS unpaid_interest, scheduled_principal - paid_principal AS unpaid_principal FROM repayment_schedule WHERE loan_account_id = #{loanAccountId} AND repayment_schedule_status_id IN (#{overdue}, #{due}) AND scheduled_interest + scheduled_principal > paid_interest + paid_principal ORDER BY scheduled_date, installment_no

SELECT a.loan_acceleration_id, a.carried_delinquency_charge - a.paid_carried_delinquency_charge AS unpaid_carried_delinquency_charge, a.carried_interest - a.paid_carried_interest AS unpaid_carried_interest, a.carried_overdue_principal - a.paid_carried_overdue_principal AS unpaid_carried_overdue_principal, la.loan_principal_balance FROM loan_acceleration a JOIN loan_account la ON la.loan_account_id = a.loan_account_id WHERE a.loan_account_id = #{loanAccountId}

SELECT acceleration_daily_charge_id AS charge_id, delinquency_charge - paid_delinquency_charge AS unpaid_delinquency_charge, interest_amount - paid_interest AS unpaid_interest FROM acceleration_daily_charge WHERE loan_acceleration_id = #{loanAccelerationId} AND delinquency_charge + interest_amount > paid_delinquency_charge + paid_interest ORDER BY charge_date, acceleration_daily_charge_id

SELECT m.loan_maturity_overdue_id, m.carried_delinquency_charge - m.paid_carried_delinquency_charge AS unpaid_carried_delinquency_charge, m.carried_interest - m.paid_carried_interest AS unpaid_carried_interest, la.loan_principal_balance FROM loan_maturity_overdue m JOIN loan_account la ON la.loan_account_id = m.loan_account_id WHERE m.loan_account_id = #{loanAccountId}

SELECT maturity_overdue_daily_charge_id AS charge_id, delinquency_charge - paid_delinquency_charge AS unpaid_delinquency_charge, interest_amount - paid_interest AS unpaid_interest FROM maturity_overdue_daily_charge WHERE loan_maturity_overdue_id = #{loanMaturityOverdueId} AND delinquency_charge > paid_delinquency_charge ORDER BY charge_date, maturity_overdue_daily_charge_id
